mapper.select: SELECT id, project_code AS projectCode, project_name AS projectName, status, agency_line_url AS agencyLineUrl FROM pm_project WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND agency_line_url IS NOT NULL AND agency_line_url != '' AND status NOT IN ('ended', 'archived') ORDER BY id

SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(real_name, ''), NULLIF(display_name, ''), username) AS displayName, status FROM sys_user WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND status = 1 AND (real_name = #{name} OR display_name = #{name} OR username = #{name}) ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE pm_agency_line_sync_batch SET status = 'failed', error_message = '上一次同步进程已结束，本次同步已自动接管', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'running' AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pm_agency_line_sync_batch ( project_id, trigger_type, status, link_snapshot, triggered_by, triggered_by_name ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{linkSnapshot}, #{triggeredBy}, #{triggeredByName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE pm_agency_line_sync_batch SET status = #{status}, spreadsheet_id = #{spreadsheetId}, sheet_gid = #{sheetGid}, sheet_title = #{sheetTitle}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, success_rows = #{successRows}, failed_rows = #{failedRows}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pm_agency_line_sync_failure ( batch_id, sheet_row_number, agency_line_name, failure_reason ) VALUES ( #{batchId}, #{sheetRowNumber}, #{agencyLineName}, #{failureReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pm_agency_line_sync_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT * FROM pm_agency_line_sync_batch WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
